fee_notes: Standard residential: $8,750 (low-density <20k pop), $17,500 (medium-density 20-70k), $35,000 (high-density 70k+). Commercial: $25,000. Team: $1,000. Financing available with higher fees; 50% down payment required. Incentives available for conversions and existing franchisees; waivers/reductions discretionary.
